IDENT.title: Digital Twin Shop-Floor: A New Shop-Floor Paradigm Towards Smart Manufacturing

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.value: Digital twin defined (after Grieves) as three parts: physical product in real space, virtual product in virtual space, and the data/information connection tying the two.
DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.evidence_quote: deﬁned as three parts, i.e. physical product in real space, virtual product in virtual space and the connection of data and information that ties the two spaces together

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_replic.evidence_quote: As the digital mirror, to simulate the physical counterpart with high ﬁdelity, VS is built in four levels, i.e. geometry, physics, behavior and rule.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_synchr.evidence_quote: During operation, models run synchronously with the physical counterparts.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_purpos.evidence_quote: providing an effective way to reach the physical-virtual convergence

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__purpose_des.value: Converge physical and virtual shop-floor to verify plans, regulate production, optimize and predict.
DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__purpose_des.evidence_quote: VS evolves with PS, providing control orders for PS and optimization strategies for SSS.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_incorp.evidence_quote: Finite state machine, neural network and complex network, etc. can be applied to describe the responsive processes.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_subjec.evidence_quote: rules of associations, constraints and deductions are modeled to describe the domain knowledge

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_data_h.evidence_quote: the history data are updated and expanded with the real-time data joining

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_data_r.evidence_quote: Data of production factors should be retrieved in real time.

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__output_type.evidence_quote: simulation, evaluation and optimization, etc. based on models are carried out in real time and generate orders to regulate the production in PS

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__uncertainty_quantifi.evidence_quote: due to the variability, uncertainty and fuzziness of physical space, building models in virtual space to mirror entities with high ﬁdelity is a fundamental issue

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__simulatable_forward_.evidence_quote: VS ﬁnds potential conﬂicts in the plan before actual production and feedbacks modiﬁcation strategies to the service.

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__model_extractable_by.evidence_quote: resources such as data, models, algorithms are encapsulated into sub-services

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__model_upda.evidence_quote: Calibration strategies are generated through comparing the models with entities to support models evolution

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__reuse_or_t.evidence_quote: For other entities in PS, the modeling processes are similar.

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__ai_tools_u.evidence_quote: To build the rule models, data mining algorithms, such as apriori, support vector machine and K-means can be used.

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__agents_present_.evidence_quote: communication protocol analysis, data encapsulation and publication, multi-agent technology, etc.

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__dt_agent_coupli.evidence_quote: VS feedbacks control orders to make PS achieve synchronism with the predeﬁned process

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__dt_makes_decisi.evidence_quote: generate orders to regulate the production in PS whenever necessary

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__spatial_represe.evidence_quote: three-dimensional geometric models are built to describe shapes, sizes, positions and assembly relations of machine components

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__part_vs_resourc.evidence_quote: PS includes a series of entities, such as human, machines and materials

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: At present, the research is in an initial stage and still needs a lot of work.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__asset_type.evidence_quote: the modeling process of CNC machine is taken as an example

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: shop-ﬂoor is the basic unit of manufacturing

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: data from different sources are transformed into uniformed interface and protocol
